data.title: 洛茜 · 挑好的小花就是送你的
data.description: 洛茜穿红兜帽斗篷与原作白裙，在花店门口把一小束雏菊举向你，脸上是藏不住的开心。狼耳从兜帽开口自然露出，蓬松尾巴弯在身后；另一只手轻轻捏着花束包装。
data.action: 双手拿着小雏菊花束递向镜头，笑着看你
data.promptProse: Rossy offers a small bunch of daisies outside the flower shop, smiling openly while her other hand pinches the wrapping. Her original red hooded cloak covers a white A-line dress, wolf ears emerging through the hood openings and her fluffy tail curving behind. The eye-level cowboy view places flower displays beside the doorway. Bright daylight touches the petals and cloak folds, shading the black waist cincher underneath.
